appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeNote: System follows your device. It is {mode} now.

storageNote.title: Stored in this browser.
storageNote.body: Clearing the browser data removes your playthroughs. Export a backup now and then.

export.title: Export
export.description: Download every playthrough and your settings as one file.

import.title: Import
import.description: Choose a backup file. You review it before anything changes.

reset.title: Reset all data
reset.warning: Deletes every playthrough and setting in this browser.
reset.confirmBody: This removes {names}. You can undo it for ten seconds.
reset.doneMessageDisconnected: {amount} {count, plural, one {playthrough} other {playthroughs}} removed. Sync is disconnected on this browser.
reset.syncedCopy: Also delete the synced copy in {provider}
reset.syncedOn: Sync stays on. Your other devices lose these playthroughs at their next sync. Export a backup first if you are not sure.
reset.syncedOff: Without this, sync is disconnected on this browser so the next sync cannot bring the playthroughs back.

playthroughs.title: Playthroughs
playthroughs.description: Create, edit, switch and delete playthroughs.

importDialog.title: Review import

errors.notJson: This file is not valid JSON.
errors.playthroughsMissing: This file is not a backup from this tracker. It has no playthroughs list.

importDialog.checks: The file lists {read} playthroughs and {kept} can be read.
importDialog.skipped: {amount} {count, plural, one {entry was} other {entries were}} skipped.

modeNotes.merge: Adds playthroughs that are new and keeps the later copy of a playthrough that exists in both. Your settings and active playthrough stay.
modeNotes.replace: Uses only what is in the file. Playthroughs that are not in the file are removed.

importDialog.undoNote: You can undo the import for ten seconds.

about.summary: A free progress tracker for Game Name. Track your progress across several playthroughs.
about.disclaimer: This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the publisher or developers of Game Name.

region.title: Language and region
region.description: How the app shows text, numbers and dates on this device. These choices are not saved with your playthroughs, not exported and not synced.

language.label: Language
language.hint: The language of the app. Names from the game stay in English.
